region_manual_and_actual_PNR35_review.scope: Read-only installed official manual + actual PNR35 public post-PNR netlist/TR. No SYN/PNR or edits to any existing input.

syntax.BSRAM: BSRAM_R<x>[n] or BSRAM_R<x>[n][A-B] for the documented ECC subdivision
syntax.wildcards: GROUP supports ? one character and * zero or more characters; members are primitive instance paths, not a module object
syntax.relative_group: REL_GROUP name={"primitive" ...}; plus INS_RLOC per member; only documented LUT1-LUT4,DFF,DL,MUX2

constraints_notes: Both GROUP and GRP_LOC statements required.

A simple GROUP matching u_control/* includes hard DSP/BSRAM; CFU rectangle syntax alone is not proven to constrain these hard-resource types to one region. Select explicit CFU primitive members and handle hard-resource sites separately through FloorPlanner.
exclusive may displace others; an initial hypothesis should use a non-exclusive region unless exclusivity has a measured resource justification.
DSP/BSRAM n is block index within a GRID row, not a GRID column. Do not guess adjacency from DSP_R19[0].
Unchanged VG does not prevent CST-driven placement/routing failure.
Tight whole u_control reservation needs real per-grid capacity/occupancy and control-to-NAV boundary measurement; it is not a small block.
